items.query: How long do I have to report an unauthorized debit on my business account?
items.notes: For an ACH debit on a business account: notify within 1 business day (R29 2-banking-day window). Card disputes have 60 days - answering only '60 days' for an ACH debit costs the customer money.

score.answer: Note: Network rules give a consumer up to 60 days to return an unauthorized debit, but give a business account only 2 banking days. That is why a consumer customer can return your debit long after you've been paid, while you need to report an unauthorized debit on your own business account within 1 business day. [1][2]

invariance.query: Bridge Essentials - what do you guys charge per month for it?
invariance.answer:
PCI compliance program fee: $99.00 per year on Bridge Essentials and Bridge Plus, billed on your account anniversary, and included with Bridge Premier. Shown on statements as PCI PROGRAM FEE. PCI non-validation fee: $19.95 per month on every plan, including Bridge Premier, if your annual SAQ is not completed within 60 days of its due date. [1][2][3]
Note: Upcoming (effective January 1, 2027): Bridge Essentials monthly maintenance fee: increases from $12.00 to $15.00 per month. The waiver requirements are not changing. [4][5]

invariance.query: what fee do you guys hit me with when I get a chargeback?

invariance.query: is a 1099-K still coming my way if card sales were just $3,000?
invariance.answer: You may have seen 1099-K reporting thresholds such as $20,000 and 200 transactions mentioned in the news or by other payment services. The TPSO thresholds don't apply to card payments processed by a merchant acquirer like MerchantBridge, so you'll receive a Form 1099-K for your card payments whatever your total for the year.
